== Who I am ==

My name is Gabriela Bittencourt, and I have been a member of the Ubuntu Kernel Team
since November 2025. I have been contributing to Linux Kernel and mentoring new contributors
in my free time since 2018, it's really nice to be doing this in my full time now :).

=== My Ubuntu story ===

Ubuntu was the first OS I had on a personal computer, at the time I was not as comfortable with
computers as I am today but Ubuntu played an important role to the developer I became.
During my studies I helped to begin a study group on Linux Kernel at my University,
during this time I could play around the Kernel project in different subsystems and help others
to have their first contact with the Linux Kernel code.
In this group we also promote some install-fests: event to help people to install Linux for the
first time on their machines -- we had a variety of distros in these events, but Ubuntu (alongside
with Debian) were the most installed ones since they are the most friendly for starters. :)

=== My involvement ===

During my time at Canonical I've studied FIPS compliance and I am focus on the FIPS kernels and aws kernels,
but I have also worked in a variety of tasks like: cranky different kernels, prepare patches, apply patches,
review patches from the mailing list, test investigation.

=== Activity ===
https://bugs.launchpad.net/~gbittencourt
